You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Clinical history (case record; may contain prior observations):
age: 31
gender: male
history: A 31-year-old man was brought to the emergency department of our hospital after being found lying unconscious in a crop field. It was reported that he had been thrown into it out after falling out from a car accident. He was in a grave condition.

A 31-year-old man was brought to the emergency department after being found unconscious following a car accident. The chest X-ray (Figure 1) showed a large focal density at the left upper lung zone and blunting of the left costophrenic angle. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis based solely on the chest X-ray findings?
A) Left upper lobe pneumonia with pleural effusion
B) Atelectasis of the left upper lobe with pleural effusion
C) Penetrating lung injury from a wooden foreign object
D) Left-sided pneumothorax with pleural effusion
E) Pulmonary contusion with associated pleural effusion
F) Left upper lobe mass with pleural effusion
